snippet.title: Trash Goblin - Coming Soon To Xbox, PS5 & Switch!
snippet.description:
Trash Goblin - the smash hit cozy shopkeeping game - is coming to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, PlayStation 5 and Switch on the 26th March 2026!

Trash Goblin is the wholesome, cosy shopkeeping game with no pressures, no stress, and endless good vibes! Uncover and clean trinkets, then upcycle them to sell to endless colourful and quirky customers. Spend your savings to upgrade your shop, buy better tools, plus expand and customise your space.

#xbox #xboxseriesx #xboxseriess #playstation5 #switch #switch2
